source.subject: test: reject M64N256 CA seed NVFP4 Gate
source.abi_scope: private test-only CUDA entry points and one test-module device-global seed

purpose.question: Can replacing the retained M64xN256 A-only-CA kernel's per-CTA scalar E4M3FN-to-BF16 codebook construction with one coalesced 512-byte global-to-shared seed remove enough setup instructions to improve Gate latency?
purpose.answer: No. The static kernel body is 24 instructions shorter and preserves HMMA, PRMT, and streaming-copy counts, but the CPU-pinned B-C-C-B short screen regresses from 5.416544 ms to 5.450288 ms and reaches only 0.993808768x versus the preset 1.008x continuation gate.
purpose.classification: reject at the preset short-screen stop-loss; do not spend six-round, NCU, or Gate+Up pair budget
purpose.retained_native_baseline: M64xN256 A-only cp.async.ca with runtime per-CTA codebook construction
purpose.production_route: unchanged hybrid direct-dequant plus cuBLASLt bridge

shape_and_topology.grid: 68 N tiles x 8 M tiles = 544 CTAs
shape_and_topology.weight_and_scale_cache_operator: packed B and scales use cp.async.cg
shape_and_topology.control_codebook_initialization: all 256 CTA threads independently decode one E4M3FN code and RNE-encode its BF16 lookup value into shared memory
shape_and_topology.candidate_codebook_initialization: warp 0 issues one 16-byte cp.async.ca per lane, collectively copying the 512-byte precomputed device-global codebook into shared memory, then commits, waits, and synchronizes the CTA
shape_and_topology.comparison_isolation: tile, arithmetic, A/B/scale cache operators, steady-state pipeline, and packed-BF16 epilogue are unchanged

seed_contract.declaration_storage: ordinary __device__ const global data; deliberately not __constant__
seed_contract.traffic_scope: the candidate adds a 512-byte logical global-to-shared seed copy per CTA; cache behavior was not profiled after the short-screen rejection

module_footprint.attribution_caveat: The binary-size delta includes the candidate/test entry points and their instantiated code in addition to the 512-byte seed, so it is not attributed solely to initialized global data.
module_footprint.statement_guard: Production routing semantics are unchanged, but neither global-data bytes nor tested binary bytes are unchanged.

sass_comparison.measurement: static instruction sites in the instantiated kernel SASS, not dynamic execution counts
sass_comparison.conclusion: The seed removes scalar setup instructions without changing the steady HMMA/PRMT body or nine streaming B/scale LDGSTS sites, but adds one cached seed-copy LDGSTS site and two DEPBAR sites. Static instruction reduction alone does not predict the measured latency.

protocol.control: retained M64xN256 A-only-CA kernel with runtime shared codebook construction
protocol.candidate: identical kernel with the ordinary device-global codebook seed
protocol.stop_loss: do not run the formal six-round screen, NCU, or Gate+Up pair unless the B-C-C-B short-screen aggregate reaches at least 1.008x

aggregate.decision: reject the seed candidate and retain the runtime-codebook A-only-CA baseline

independent_audit.findings: no blocking seed-table, exhaustive-value, bounds, alignment, resource, Graph, production-isolation, or stop-loss findings

decision.candidate: rejected at the bounded short-screen stop-loss
decision.retained_value: keep the test-only implementation and SASS/ELF evidence as a sentinel that removing 24 static setup instructions does not amortize the ordinary-global seed copy and synchronization
decision.retained_native_baseline: M64xN256 A-only cp.async.ca with runtime codebook construction
decision.physical_test_module: changed by a 512-byte initialized device-global seed, additional candidate/test code, and a 67,896-byte tested-binary size increase

next_bounded_work.direction: a structural decode or instruction-scheduling change with a credible path beyond the retained baseline's remaining admission gap
next_bounded_work.scope_guard: use a preset short stop-loss before full six-round, NCU, and pair evidence

do_not_repeat: do not describe unchanged production dispatch semantics as unchanged module-global or binary bytes
do not infer latency improvement from a lower static instruction count alone
do not spend six-round, NCU, or pair budget after the 1.008x short continuation gate fails
do not route MTP as a shortcut
